commands.name: camera.apps
commands.description: List the camera apps this device offers, and which one camera.open would use.

commands.name: camera.capture
commands.description: Take a still photograph with the rear camera and save it on the device.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Destination directory. Must be inside the agent's writable roots.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Bare filename. Defaults to a UTC timestamp.

parameters.name: publishToGallery
parameters.description: Also index the photo in MediaStore so it appears in the gallery.

commands.name: camera.open
commands.description: Open the device's camera app. The lens hint is best-effort and app-dependent.

parameters.name: lens
parameters.description: 'front' or 'rear'. A hint only; camera apps are free to ignore it.

parameters.name: package
parameters.description: Open a specific camera app instead of the device default.

commands.name: device.getprop
commands.description: Read one or more Android system properties.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: A single property name, e.g. ro.product.model.

parameters.name: keys
parameters.description: Several property names to read in one request. Takes precedence over 'key'.

commands.name: system.commands
commands.description: List every command this agent supports, with its parameters.

commands.name: system.ping
commands.description: Check that the agent is reachable and report the device clock.

commands.name: system.status
commands.description: Report the device, its permissions, and whether the agent is fully set up.
